risks.risk: The keyboard may not power on or produce sound.
risks.proof: A video showing the device powered on and playing a demo song or individual keys.

risks.risk: Individual keys may be dead or sticky.
risks.proof: A video of every key being pressed and sounding.

risks.risk: The LCD screen may have dead pixels or no backlight.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the screen while the unit is powered on.

risks.risk: The power adapter may be missing or third-party.
risks.proof: A photo of the power adapter and its connector.

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powered on, showing the screen and playing through the keys.
Photo of the rear panel showing the ports.
Photo of the included power adapter.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identified from the photo. It can be priced at its worst-case (non-functional) value until proof of operation is provided.
